visual.general_description: Two adjacent unlettered clinical photographs of the periumbilical abdominal skin.
visual.detailed_description: Two photographs are separated by a broad white vertical gutter with no printed panel letters. The left view shows wrinkled pale-tan abdominal skin, small rounded raised areas and the umbilicus near its right border; two red arrows point toward skin elevations at the lower-left and upper-middle. The right view shows the umbilicus near the left edge with three red arrows pointing to raised pale areas in the center and lower-right. Dark clothing is partly visible along the lower borders. No ruler, scale, date, numerical measurement or patient name is legible.
